design_rules.student_simplicity: The learner will eventually see guided journeys and short review, not classification machinery.
design_rules.locus_rule: A permanent locus is used for a distinct spatial or causal concept cluster, not for every canonical record.
design_rules.embedded_rule: Closely related structure/function details share the locus that makes their relationship visible.
design_rules.practice_rule: Applied-transfer records remain in Challenge Lab and do not consume palace loci.
design_rules.narrative_gate: No story prose may be written until this F2 architecture passes QA and is explicitly locked.
design_rules.visual_rule: Conventional scientific geometry must remain recognizable even when narrative imagery is added later.
design_rules.spelling_rule: No mandatory spelling gauntlet; spelling support is adaptive and only appears when useful.

journeys.content_focus: Cell identity, nucleus, ribosomes, endomembrane flow, recycling/storage, and cytoskeleton
journeys.setting_logic: A coherent operations complex supports physical movement from information control to protein production, processing, recycling, storage, and internal structural support.
A power-conversion annex makes nested membranes, compartments, surface area, and energy-conversion structures spatially explicit without mixing them into the already dense endomembrane route.

journeys.content_focus: Surface-area-to-volume relationships, cell-size constraints, exchange surfaces, and organism scaling
journeys.setting_logic: A modeling observatory lets learners compare geometrically similar objects at different scales and watch exchange and thermal consequences change with size.

journeys.content_focus: Membrane structure, fluidity, proteins, recognition, selective permeability, cell walls, and plasmodesmata
journeys.setting_logic: A border terminal gives the membrane one stable spatial metaphor: a dynamic boundary with a molecular fabric, embedded workers, recognition markers, selective lanes, and an external plant-cell wall.

journeys.content_focus: Diffusion, passive/active transport, facilitated diffusion, channels/carriers, bulk transport, electrochemical gradients, pumps, and cotransport
journeys.setting_logic: A multilevel transit hub makes direction, gradients, energy use, transport proteins, vesicles, and coupled movement visible as different ways of crossing the same boundary.

journeys.content_focus: Tonicity, osmosis, water potential, plant-cell water responses, and osmoregulation
journeys.setting_logic: A glass conservatory with controlled solution chambers makes water movement and plant-cell responses visible while separating conceptual tonicity from quantitative water-potential work.
An origins archive lets learners first compare internal organization, then examine endosymbiosis as an evidence-supported historical explanation rather than a decorative fantasy event.
